item.title: Sino-Europe Young Leadership in Bioeconomy: Mountain Futures Summer School
item.description:
I joined the Sino-Europe Young Leadership in Bioeconomy: Mountain Futures Summer School in Yunnan, China, from August 12–25, 2026. The summer school was hosted by Mountain Futures and the Landscape Alliance (CIFOR & ICRAF), together with the Chinese Academy of Sciences and a range of supporting partners.

More details and photos to follow.
